newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian top shares close firmer in busy trade.
newsitem.headline: Croatian top shares close firmer in busy trade.

text.p: Croatian stocks traded mixed, with fully-listed drugs firm Pliva and Zagrebacka Banka closing on a firmer note in buoyant activity.
* Six of 15 active issues rose, six fell and three were flat.
* Volume rose to 17,259 shares from 4,837; turnover was more than six times higher at 19.9 million kuna.
* Top gainer Zagrebacka Banka added 48.55 kuna or 2.4 percent to 2,060 kuna, selling 7,044 shares.
* Biggest decliner hotelier Jadranturist lost nine kuna to 305, with 115 units sold.
* Most active Pliva traded on volume of 7,321 units, edging up six kuna to 485 after peaking at 489 kuna earlier in the session. -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
